text_block_list.name: Opera O & Doto
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What a pity.
...To think that a star such as myself would fall.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I will accept it fully. But
the play is not yet over... Wouldn't you agree, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...!
I will, too...—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll get even stronger, too...! Next time, at the Tenno Sho (Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... gh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haha... What's that supposed to mean?
"You understand"? Understand what...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I won, sure. But... what about next time?
They evolved even in the middle of the race.
That approaching murderous intent—)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (She exceeded the numbers. The theoretical value calculated perfectly for victory... she surpassed it as if it were the most natural thing in the world.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dammit...
I won, damn it...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I got carried away. Because I changed those seven centimeters...
Because I thought I had changed destiny...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Even though this... was supposed to be my destiny.
(Murmur... murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: —I mean, what's the deal with that?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: This year's Classic generation... or rather, Air Shakur. Sure, she's amazing, but... it feels kind of like a fluke.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... the Triple Crown races
weren't all that exciting either.
There wasn't a duo like Ope and Doto around."

"—Guess she's just been lucky so far.
Once the younger generation steps up, she won't stand a chance.
This is the end of the line for Air Shakur."

...What if they're overwhelmingly weak—
—the representatives of the "weakest generation"...—

When Air Shakur returned,
something was clearly off about him.
choice_data_list: Let's head home as soon as we change

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Oh, that reminds me, about today's race—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Doto-chan really gave it her all.
It made me want to cheer for her even more!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*
choice_data_list: The taxi will be here soon, so—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's fine.
You... get on.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ah!
choice_data_list: Because it's still quieter inside the academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Understood.

Even inside the taxi,
Air Shakur did not utter a single word.
choice_data_list: I'll contact you right away tomorrow

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Wait.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is...
the Tenno Sho (Spring), just as planned.

The Tenno Sho (Spring) is the longest GI race at 3,200m.
It's an event that will truly bring out
Air Shakur's strengths over long distances.
However, this race had—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
First of all, those two from today without a doubt...
and Narita Top Road should be entering as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I will rethink our strategy against them.
I'll gather new data, and then...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Training…… that surpasses even that……
choice_data_list: Let's save that conversation for tomorrow too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: Let's make next year your era.
Let's make next year your era.

text_block_list.text:
I watch Air Shakur's back.
But that isn't the only way.
Now, I finally know what I need to do.
choice_data_list: (I'll just tell them what I saw.)
(All I can do is tell what I saw.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (Calm down. The data is compiled. All that's left is to calculate the theoretical value for victory.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Even if that number's absurd...
I've just gotta do it, don't I?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(What's this... the results are displayed already?
And what's more――)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this the exact same result as before?!
The worst fate possible, from before that '7 cm' changed...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
At this rate...
nothin's changed at all, has it?

"...What if they're overwhelmingly weak—
—representatives of the 'weakest generation'......—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I see. Even you...
want to bring me down, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: 『Parcae』――
